research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Razorpay is researching systems for managing payments for multiple users, as described in 'Simultaneous transactions on shared display devices using scannable codes.' The abstract details a scanning-based system with order processing kiosks and display panels, enabling receipt and management of multiple user orders and facilitating payment processing. This work highlights Razorpay’s focus on developing technologies for efficient, multi-user payment acceptance and processing.

overview_description.description:
Razorpay is a platform that enables businesses to accept, process, and disburse payments with its product suite. It gives access to all payment modes including credit card, debit card, net banking, UPI and popular wallets including JioMoney, Mobikwik, Airtel Money, FreeCharge, Ola Money, and PayZapp.

The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka.
